status: One-time historical holdout; precommitted method, no changes after examining 2021 results
frozenMethod: For each game, use strictly earlier 2021 scores if both teams have >=2 prior games; otherwise use completed 2020 regular season. Strength=0.7*season average point differential+0.3*last-three point differential, home advantage +1.5. Predict home if edge>=0.
cautions: 2021 was not used in the documented 2023-2025 early-season experiment; nevertheless historical tests are not prospective validation.
2020 to 2021 franchise-name changes could cause missing prior-team matches; results should be audited before interpreting.
